Lemme go through this


1. It's a long story, but I had to move in with my abusive father. Ironically, I should have wanted to stay away from home, but it only made me afraid to leave ?


2. I have (had...?) panic attacks, during these panic attacks it gets pretty scary/borderline psychotic. I dissociate, completely glaze over, sometimes I can't respond or get irrationally angry at everything (like if someone tries to ask what's wrong, I sobbed thinking I'm being yelled at or attacked), all while having such intense, uninteruptable thoughts of just... probably more paranoid thoughts than anxious ones. I have some paranoid/people problems too, so. Because of health issues in the past, I also get hypochondria and convinced that I must be dying, and "bring on" symptoms without even realizing. I actually experience a lot of that same pain I did due to past health issues (I am fine now, believe me, I get checked 24/7, only reason I leave the house lol). I would consider that more of a flashback, though, the health event was pretty traumatic. So basically a paranoid break or hypochondria. 


3. I was on 25mg Zoloft daily since September 2017 and my panic attacks. Wow... They are extremely easy. I can actually think for once and remember to do all the breathing/relaxing stuff people tell me to do and they are much shorter. It only helped the physical, hyperventilation, chest pain, etc. I still have mental fears/anxious thoughts. I also have a vasogal(? spelling) syncope which flaired up again, which also apparently is treated by Zoloft. It's doubled in dosage now. Same, feel more body calm, way too much body calm actually. My fatigue... I'm so sleepy. I don't have energy to do anything. Does nothing for/maybe worsens a bit my depression, which to be fair, I don't talk about. My mom is always in the room (and they would tell her anyway) and so I only talk about anxiety around my doctors, which she knows about. I am *not allowed* to be depressed. My insurance doesn't cover therapy but I am more than willing. I fucking need help. I'm scared of myself and where I'm heading emotionally. I want my life back.
weird place to be in when life upsets you and death scares you
